name: hamed ghasempour
title: devops engineer
bio: DevOps engineer building and operating systems end to end — infrastructure, virtualization, networking, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, and the tooling around them.
intro: I like building and operating systems end to end, from infrastructure, virtualization, and networking to containers, automation, CI/CD, monitoring, and the tooling around them. I also enjoy building small apps, plugins, scripts, and internal tools when something can be made simpler or automated.

Most of my work sits around infrastructure, platform, reliability, cloud, networking, and automation engineering. I lean toward open source and self-hosting, and I'm also interested in AI infrastructure, tooling, and practical AI integrations.
